name: Waypoint Scenes
tagline: See more carefully. Understand how you see. Grow a quieter photographic voice.
mission: Waypoint Scenes is one photography experience — coaching for each frame, room to experiment with how nature can look beyond ordinary vision, and paths toward living atmospheres, built scenes, and a lifelong private companion for your looking.

experiences.title: Photo Coach
experiences.summary: Learn from each photograph through practical, personalized coaching.
experiences.description: Upload a frame and receive careful feedback — what is working, what could improve, and a next step. Sessions stay private in this browser.

experiences.title: Hidden Landscapes
experiences.summary: Explore surreal and invisible interpretations of nature through spectral concepts, false color, and alternative visual systems.
experiences.description: A local-first studio for creative landscape interpretations inspired by infrared and beyond-visible photography — clearly labeled as artistic simulations, not spectral captures.

experiences.title: Moving Scenes
experiences.summary: Add subtle, localized environmental motion to still photography.
experiences.description: Preserve the photograph — then animate only confident regions such as clouds, water, or fog. No generative video. Processed on this device.

experiences.title: Scene Builder
experiences.summary: Create interactive photographic environments and stories from still frames.
experiences.description: An early studio for atmosphere and depth on a photograph. The fuller storytelling vision continues to grow; this preview points to the current surface when you want to experiment.

experiences.title: Photographer Profile
experiences.summary: A private intelligence layer that learns your interests, visual tendencies, strengths, and growth over time.
experiences.description: The companion that remembers how you see — not a social profile, portfolio, or ranking. An early companion already grows beside Photo Coach; this page is the product preview for that long arc.
